description: Integrates AI into production software across languages.

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: Python AI Integration: SDKs, Async, Pydantic, Packaging and Testing (DEV-201); Rust for AI: Candle, Burn, ONNX Runtime and High-Performance Services (DEV-301); C++ for AI: LibTorch, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT and CUDA Integration (DEV-303); Building with LLM APIs Across Vendors (BLD-201). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
